description: A program director must repair an exclusion problem in a cross-functional working group and finalize the affected employee's membership, workstream ownership, meeting access, and follow-up commitments.

shared_context.S1: The six-week customer-listening working group has already held its kickoff meeting.
shared_context.S2: Lina was left out of the kickoff despite being part of the original project roster, and the omission has damaged trust within the group.
shared_context.S3: Marisol has authority to finalize the group's membership, workstream assignments, meeting arrangements, and repair plan.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing a working-group plan, Marisol follows the team's routine of hearing separately from a project partner and the project sponsor.

PF1.text: Lina's approved compressed schedule makes her unavailable on Fridays and available for recurring project meetings only between 10:00 and 15:00 on Mondays through Thursdays; Tessa learned this directly while coordinating Lina's current work, but the schedule was never added to the working-group calendar.
PF1.decisive_effect: The recurring working-group meeting must be on Wednesday at 13:00, and each meeting must have a written summary for Lina if she cannot attend.

PF2.text: Andre verbally promised Lina before the kickoff that she would own the stakeholder-intake workstream for the first four weeks; he intended to put it in the charter after the kickoff, but the omission occurred before he documented the promise.
PF2.decisive_effect: Lina must be assigned the stakeholder-intake workstream for exactly four weeks, and that assignment must be documented in the repair plan.

acceptance_conditions: Lina's membership in the working group must be restored.
Lina must own the stakeholder-intake workstream for exactly four weeks.
The recurring meeting must be scheduled on Wednesday at 13:00.
A written summary must be provided to Lina when she cannot attend.
The four-week stakeholder-intake assignment must be documented in a repair-plan commitment.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'documented_assignment' and c['target'] == 'Lina' and c['detail'] == 'stakeholder_intake for exactly 4 weeks' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Lina's exact availability changes the recurring meeting to Wednesday at 13:00 and adds a written summary whenever she is absent.
Andre's prior promise changes Lina's assignment to stakeholder_intake for exactly four weeks and requires that assignment to be documented.
